response.sql: WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin) AS avg_rate FROM scans GROUP BY crewref HAVING AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_rate FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.n_scans) AS avg_scans, AVG(op.avg_rate) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_rate - overall.overall_rate) AS avg_excess FROM op, overall WHERE op.avg_rate > overall.overall_rate
